en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far

<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who divorced his wife and she was pregnant, can he marry her sister before she places (gives birth)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He cannot marry her until her term is cleared’.
en.sarwar: 8. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Zurarah who has said the following:

“About the case of a man who divorces his wife and she is pregnant; if he can marry her sister before she gives birth, he (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He must not marry her until her time is complete.’”
